mainnet._comment: Rincoin mainnet. init = the world as it is today; eras = future overlays. Era 0 is positioned at 3 * nSubsidyHalvingInterval (= 3 * 210000 = 630000), aligning with the third halving boundary, the point at which the new infrastructure becomes consensus-active.

init._comment: Frozen pre-eras parameters; identical to the values that were hardcoded in chainparams.cpp / rinhash.cpp. No coinbase marker, no fork tx version, and no extra peer-protocol-version floor before era 0 activates.

eras._comment: Era 0 introduces the post-eras infrastructure. PoW unchanged. Coinbase OP_RETURN marker (52 49 4e 31 = 'RIN1') and fork tx nVersion (0x52494e33 = 'RIN3' BE = 1380535859) become required from this height; peers below the floor are disconnected.

testnet._comment: Testnet. Era 0 sits at 3 * nSubsidyHalvingInterval (= 3 * 1050 = 3150) so functional tests reach it in seconds.

regtest._comment: Regtest. Era 0 sits at 3 * nSubsidyHalvingInterval (= 3 * 150 = 450) so regtest functional tests can sweep both regimes within a single run.
